set.title: Foundry wafer pricing: price by node, pricing unit, annual increases and pass-through
questions: What is the pricing unit for foundry wafers (per wafer, per good die, per mask layer) and does it differ by node or customer?
What public evidence exists on wafer prices by node (N2/N3/N5/N7, 28nm, 40nm+, 200mm) and on annual price changes 2020-2026?
How do foundry blended revenue per wafer (from shipments and revenue) compare across TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, SMIC, Hua Hong?
What discounts, volume tiers or price increases for overseas fabs (Arizona, Kumamoto) have been disclosed or credibly reported?
What share of a chip's cost is the wafer, by product type?
subquestions: Revenue per 300mm/8-inch-equivalent wafer calculated from company disclosures (state method)
TSMC statements on price increases and overseas-fab pricing
Contradictions between press-reported wafer prices
primary_sources: TSMC quarterly management reports and earnings call transcripts (revenue by node, wafer shipments; investor.tsmc.com)
UMC 20-F and quarterly reports (wafer shipments, ASP commentary)
GlobalFoundries 10-K (wafer shipments, revenue per wafer)
SMIC and Hua Hong quarterly reports (HKEX: ASP, wafer shipments)
secondary_sources: TrendForce / DigiTimes reporting on wafer price changes (tier 2/3; record as estimates)
CSET 'AI Chips: What They Are and Why They Matter' (2020) cost model
open_questions: Questions on prepayments and LTA renegotiation moved to new unit 'Foundry capacity reservation, prepayments and shortfall enforcement across the 2021-2024 cycle'.

set.title: Distribution channel economics: margins, ship-and-debit, price protection, stock rotation and the direct vs distribution split
questions: What share of chip sales goes through authorised distributors, by chipmaker and by segment (analog/MCU vs logic/memory)?
How do ship-and-debit, price protection, stock rotation and scrap allowances work, and how are they recognised by chipmakers (variable consideration)?
What gross and operating margins and inventory days do the large distributors (Arrow, Avnet, WPG, WT Microelectronics, Future) report on semiconductors?
How have chipmakers changed channel policy (e.g. TI moving customers direct, Microchip distributor inventory) and what did it do to distributor economics?
How do Asian distributors (WPG, WT, Macnica, Kyokuyo) differ from US/EU (Arrow, Avnet) in model and margin?
subquestions: Distributor 'sell-in vs sell-through' revenue recognition
Distribution share disclosed by TI, Microchip, ADI, NXP, ST, Infineon
Distributor value-added services (design-in, demand creation fees)
primary_sources: Arrow and Avnet 10-K (segment margins, inventory)
WPG Holdings and WT Microelectronics annual reports (MOPS)
Macnica Holdings annual securities report
TI, Microchip, ADI, NXP 10-K revenue-recognition notes (price protection, ship-and-debit, distribution share)
secondary_sources: ECIA industry reports (to verify public access)
open_questions: RU-0043 (value_chain) covers channel structure; this unit covers economics only.

set.title: Government money flows into semiconductors: Japan, South Korea and Taiwan (grants, tax credits, policy loans, state equity)
questions: What grants, subsidies and equity has Japan given (JASM, Rapidus, Kioxia/Western Digital, Micron Hiroshima) under the 2021-2025 funds and the 2025 information-processing promotion framework, with amounts per recipient?
What tax credits, policy loans (KDB low-rate programme) and infrastructure support has South Korea given (K-Chips Act, Yongin cluster), with amounts per recipient where disclosed?
What has Taiwan provided (Statute for Industrial Innovation Article 10-2, land/utility support, National Development Fund stakes) and to whom?
How are awards disbursed and clawed back in each country?
How material are incentives relative to recipients' capex (company-disclosed grants and tax credits)?
subquestions: Japan: NEDO post-5G fund and Rapidus funding tranches; JASM subsidy amounts
Korea: tax credit rates by firm size and year; Samsung/SK hynix tax credit amounts in audit reports
Taiwan: TSMC tax credits in annual report; National Development Fund holdings in TSMC
primary_sources: METI press releases on subsidy approvals (JASM, Micron, Kioxia, Rapidus)
NEDO post-5G fund project pages
Rapidus announcements
MOTIE / Ministry of Economy and Finance K-Chips Act and semiconductor support package releases
KDB semiconductor lending programme announcement (to verify)
Samsung Electronics and SK hynix audit reports on DART (government grants, tax credits)
TSMC annual report (tax credits, government grants)
Taiwan Statute for Industrial Innovation Article 10-2 (law.moj.gov.tw)
open_questions: Scope narrowed: China -> new unit 'China's state and quasi-state capital'; EU/Israel -> 'European and Israeli public money for fabs'; India/SEA -> 'India and Southeast Asia public money'. US federal remains RU-0026.

set.title: Equipment makers' commercial model: system pricing, customer down payments, acceptance, services and upgrades
questions: Do chipmakers pay deposits or down payments on tools (EUV, High-NA), how large are equipment makers' customer advances/contract liabilities, and when is revenue recognised (shipment vs acceptance)?
What are list or reported prices of key tools (EUV, High-NA EUV, DUV immersion, etch, deposition, inspection) and how did they change?
How are service contracts, spares and upgrades priced, and what share of revenue and margin do installed-base services provide?
How concentrated is equipment revenue by customer and region (China share 2022-2026)?
How do Chinese equipment makers (Naura, AMEC) price and compete domestically?
subquestions: ASML customer down payments and contract liabilities
Applied Materials AGS subscription share
Tokyo Electron and KLA service revenue
Revenue by region disclosures
primary_sources: ASML annual report (contract liabilities, down payments, installed base management)
Applied Materials, Lam Research, KLA 10-K (customer deposits, services, revenue by region)
Tokyo Electron and Advantest annual securities reports / integrated reports
Naura and AMEC annual reports (SZSE/SSE)
SEMI WWSEMS
open_questions: RU-0042 (value_chain) covers segment map and supplier concentration; this unit covers commercial terms and service economics.

set.title: Packaging and test unit economics: OSAT pricing basis, utilisation, advanced-packaging capex and the foundry-vs-OSAT split
questions: How are OSAT services priced (per unit, per wafer, per test-second, per bump) and how does advanced packaging pricing differ from conventional?
How much advanced-packaging revenue is captured by foundries (TSMC CoWoS/SoIC, Intel, Samsung) versus OSATs, 2022-2026?
What capex and utilisation do OSATs and advanced-packaging lines require, and how do margins move with utilisation?
How are test services (final test, burn-in, SLT) priced and who owns the testers (OSAT vs customer-consigned)?
How do Chinese OSATs (JCET, Tongfu, Huatian) compare on margin and pricing?
subquestions: ASE ATM vs group margins
Amkor advanced-packaging share
TSMC advanced packaging revenue share statements
Test houses (KYEC) economics
primary_sources: ASE and Amkor annual reports/20-F/10-K
JCET, Tongfu, Huatian annual reports (SSE/SZSE)
KYEC and Powertech annual reports (MOPS)
TSMC earnings calls (advanced packaging share of revenue)
open_questions: RU-0007/RU-0044 cover structure; this unit covers pricing and economics.

questions: For 3-5 firms per business model (fabless, IDM logic, memory, analog IDM, leading-edge foundry, mature foundry, OSAT, WFE, test equipment, EDA, IP, distributor, materials), what are revenue, gross margin, operating margin, capex/revenue and R&D/revenue for each calendar year 2019-2025?
What is return on invested capital by business model over the same cycle?
How do fiscal-year conventions and accounting standards (US GAAP, IFRS, TIFRS, J-GAAP, K-IFRS) affect comparability, and how should figures be aligned?
Does the discovery pattern (margins rise away from physical capital, CLM-0298) hold across the full sample and cycle?
subquestions: Extract TSMC and NVIDIA R&D figures missing from discovery (CLM-0173, CLM-0195)
Record calculation method in each inference claim
primary_sources: 10-K/20-F/annual reports and audited financial statements of the sampled firms (SEC EDGAR, MOPS, DART, EDINET, HKEX)
secondary_sources: SIA State of the Industry (R&D and capex ratios)
open_questions: Sample should be reused by the working-capital unit and the wage/labour-cost unit.

set.title: Design-IP and patent-licensing royalty economics: licence fees, per-chip royalty rates and device-level patent licensing
questions: How are IP licence fees and royalty rates set and reported (per chip, % of chip ASP, in arrears) for Arm, Synopsys IP, Cadence IP, Rambus, CEVA, Imagination, Alphawave?
How have Arm's royalty rates changed (v9, Compute Subsystems) and how concentrated are its licensees (e.g. China via Arm China)?
How does Qualcomm's QTL device-level licensing work (percent of device wholesale price, caps) and how large is it versus QCT chip revenue?
What licensing disputes (Arm v Qualcomm, Qualcomm antitrust cases) changed flows and how?
How large is RISC-V adoption as a substitute for royalty-bearing ISAs, and how do RISC-V IP vendors (SiFive, Andes) earn money?
subquestions: Arm royalty revenue per chip (calculated, method stated)
Arm China relationship and related-party revenue
Andes Technology annual report royalty share
primary_sources: Arm 20-F / 10-K and F-1 prospectus (2023)
Qualcomm 10-K (QTL segment)
Rambus and CEVA 10-K
Andes Technology annual report (MOPS)
Court records: Arm v. Qualcomm (D. Del.)
